name: FlareForward Starship 2 (50,000 FLR)
description: A 12 month FlareForward bond backing the FlareForward validator on Flare. At maturity the holder redeems the bond for an equal per-bond share of what the treasury has returned to the bond vault. The amount is not guaranteed. The bond does not renew. Details at ftso.flareforward.com/nft/redeem.
